unit: Pediatric PN development and monitoring: additional source intake
status: source intake completed; content revision and clinical closure pending

sourcePolicy.authorization: Existing approved PN source exception: official ASPEN/FDA material and directly linked primary PN guidance.

sources.title: ASPEN PN Prescribing Checklist
sources.tableReviewed: Table 1: all rows, grouped acute-care/long-term headings, frequency columns, abbreviations, source note, and professional-judgment qualification.
sources.findings: The pediatric template expresses component delivery per kilogram per day and identifies the dosing weight. Monitoring depends on care setting and stability. The laboratory table distinguishes baseline, early acute care, stable acute care, and long-term intervals; it does not make one interval universal. Serum proteins are framed as inflammation markers.

sources.title: FDA CLINIMIX labeling, 2021
sources.scope: Relevant complete pages, including pregnancy/lactation/geriatric context; not the full 21-page label and not a current-label claim.
sources.findings: The label describes neonatal glycemic vulnerability, immature renal handling, and individualized electrolyte monitoring. It treats hepatobiliary disease as multifactorial and calls for clinical assessment of contributors. Renal dysfunction may require changes to fluid, protein, and electrolyte content. Its peripheral-access warning concerns the specified CLINIMIX formulations; it cannot alone verify every pediatric device claim.

sources.title: ASPEN PN Safety Consensus Recommendations, 2014
sources.access: Publisher full-text HTML through web reader; no access-control bypass.
sources.completeRelevantSectionRead: Administration 3: all 18 recommendation groups and complete rationale through Documentation, including vascular access, filters, tubing, infusion practices, and medication administration.
sources.locator: Publisher section Administration 3; Vascular access rationale; Documentation rationale.
sources.findings: Incorrect sampling from a PN-infusing device can produce falsely elevated results and harmful intervention. This supports checking specimen validity while assessing the patient, rather than presuming contamination or ignoring true hyperglycemia. Documentation covers administration times, rate, route, response, and therapeutic progress. The old filter-size scheme differs from the newer verified ASPEN filter position and will not replace it.

sources.title: ASPEN PN Order Review and Verification Checklist
sources.findings: Review dosing weight, units, current nutrition plan, ingredient doses, volume, rate, and changes from the previous order. A change in measured weight requires reconciling the prescribed dosing weight and clinical plan; it does not automatically mandate proportional increases in all nutrient grams.

sources.title: Supplied RxPrep 2023 Chapter 54
sources.scope: Developmental physiology and age classifications; not a PN dosing protocol.
